llm.evidence: All mass spectrometry data was acquired in centroid mode on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer
carry out whole-cell proteomics of tandem mass tag (TMT) 10-plex samples
incubated overnight with 1:50 LysC (Wako Chemicals) and 1:100 Sequencing grade trypsin (Promega).
use iron loaded nitrilotriacetic acid (Fe-NTA) phosphopeptide enrichment
a synchronous precursor selection (SPS) multi-notch MS3 method was used
fragmented using CID with a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 35%... fragmented using HCD with an NCE of 65%... fragmented via HCD applying an NCE of 38%.
Static modifications were set as TMT6 at the N terminus and lysines and carbamidomethyl at cysteine residues.
